title: Require Service Contract Property Descriptions
forbids: a directly authored TypeBox object property in a service module contract without a nonblank static description
why: Contract properties are public protocol vocabulary. Their semantic meaning must travel with the owned schema and remain available to generated protocol documentation.
remediate: Use the canonical Type import and add a truthful static description, delegate to a named *Schema authority, or spread a named *Schema.properties authority.
message: Directly authored service contract properties must declare their meaning.
